name: Jonas's A-to-mid-B jump — the earlier leg is the real problem
summary: Reuses existing, already-verified single-step personas rather than new answer data: a-to-low-b's 'notyet-ambitious-and-shaken' (gated Not yet — rough air catches him out, lost control of a collapse) paired with low-b-to-mid-b's 'ready-earned-the-step' (a clean Ready). Tests that the chain correctly focuses on the EARLIER leg when it's the one blocking, even though the later leg alone would be fine.
